mechanisms.behavior: The 4-ball physical trough uses position sensors 18-21 and jam sensor 22. The working script initializes 4 balls and output 1 ejects from the right end.
mechanisms.label: 4-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: Output 2 fires a ball at matrix switch 23. The working script uses a 0.6-second impulse and power 55 with 0.5 randomness as a proven baseline.
mechanisms.label: Auto launcher

mechanisms.behavior: A ball rests on switch 62 until output 5 ejects it. The working script uses angle 25, force 20, and route variance.
mechanisms.label: Hulk eject

mechanisms.behavior: Switches 52-55 stay down independently. main output 6 resets all four targets.
mechanisms.label: HULK four-drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: Outputs 3 and 4 drive opposite Hulk rotation directions. Wheel optos 41 and 42 report indexed motion; stop each drive at the intended sensed position and never energize both directions together.
mechanisms.label: Rotating Hulk assembly

mechanisms.behavior: Main output 17 through the step-up driver board raises the Hulk arms while active and lowers them when released. The table animation moves from roughly 130 to 200 degrees in two-degree timer steps.
mechanisms.label: Hulk arm lift

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 57 reports a ball on the Hulk platter. Main output 23 through the step-up driver board energizes the magnet; the working table uses radius 16 and centers the captured ball.
mechanisms.label: Hulk platter magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Three active-low optos are initialized high when empty and fall low as balls occupy positions bottom-to-top. Output 22 through the step-up driver board drops the retaining post/releases locked balls.
mechanisms.label: Three-ball Loki lock

mechanisms.behavior: The playfield ball physically spins the Tesseract; it has no controller motor. Opposed optos 45 and 46 pulse as the inertial wheel crosses their positions. Preserve free rotation, collision-derived angular velocity, and gradual drag.
mechanisms.label: Inertial Tesseract spinner

mechanisms.behavior: Left, right, and bottom pop switches 30-32 directly correspond to outputs 9-11; the shared pop flasher is output 25.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Slingshot switches 26/27 drive outputs 13/14 and share flasher output 20.
mechanisms.label: Left and right slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: The two lower flippers use outputs 15/16, dedicated cabinet buttons D9/D11, and normally-closed EOS contacts D10/D12. Preserve SAM fast-flip behavior.
mechanisms.label: Lower flipper pair

mechanisms.behavior: The Pro uses four independently sensed THOR targets at switches 1-4. Unlike LE, the Pro manual and working script provide no THOR reset actuator; do not copy the LE drop-bank output into this machine.
mechanisms.label: THOR four-target bank

mechanisms.behavior: Output 7 opens the left orbit gate and output 12 raises the left ramp control gate. Both return closed when their drive releases. The Pro has no LE eight-transistor gate outputs.
mechanisms.label: Left orbit and ramp control gates
